meta.name: map-systems
meta.description: 将游戏概念拆解为独立系统，映射依赖关系，确定设计优先级，并创建系统索引。

copy.tagline: 拆解游戏概念为系统，映射依赖并确定优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在设计游戏系统，需要理清模块依赖和开发顺序
copy.tagline_en: Decompose game concepts into systems, map dependencies, and set priorities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing game systems and need to clarify module dependencies and development order

howto.what: Claude 会把一个游戏概念拆解成独立的子系统，列出依赖关系，排出设计顺序，最终生成系统索引文档。
howto.when: 用 /map-systems 命令触发完整拆解流程；或输入 /map-systems next 直接跳转到下一个待设计系统。

say.text: 帮我把我的游戏创意拆成系统并排优先级。
say.note: 触发完整的工作流，从读取概念到创建索引。

say.text: 继续设计下一个未开始的系统。

howto.what_en: Claude will break down a game concept into independent subsystems, map dependencies, determine design priority, and create a systems index document.
howto.when_en: Use `/map-systems` to start the full decomposition workflow; use `/map-systems next` to jump to the next unstarted system.

say_en.text: Break down my game idea into systems and prioritize them.
say_en.note: Triggers the full workflow from reading the concept to creating the index.

say_en.text: Continue to design the next unstarted system.
say_en.note: Selects the highest-priority unfinished system and hands off to /design-system.
